faqs.a: Your plumber works out what's wrong first, and that diagnosis sets the price. You review the numbers before any work begins, and the next step is your call - nothing starts until you approve it.
faqs.q: How do I find out what a repair will cost?

faqs.a: Yes. We answer the phone 24/7, and weekends and holidays carry no after-hours fees. Call (912) 388-9997 any time, day or night.
faqs.q: Will anyone answer if a pipe bursts after midnight?

faqs.a: Yes - if there's any delay, it's you we pay. We pay you $5.00 for each minute we're late, up to 60 minutes (or $300 maximum).
faqs.q: Do you pay me if the plumber is late?

faqs.a: Usually one. Thousands of parts ride in our service vehicles, so most problems are resolved on the first visit.
faqs.q: How many trips will it take to finish my repair?

faqs.a: Our technicians wear uniforms and drive marked vehicles. Each one is licensed and has passed a background check, so you know who is at the door - and every job is covered by our 100% satisfaction guarantee.
faqs.q: What should I expect when your plumber arrives?

faqs.a: We serve Savannah Metro and Pooler, GA - our shop is at 1744 Old Dean Forest in Pooler. Call (912) 388-9997 and tell us what you need.
